policies.title: American Samoa: named Entry Permit Waiver Program passports
policies.summary: The current American Samoa Administrative Code names these citizenships for a 30-day Entry Permit Waiver Program route, but requires prior approved OK-to-Board authorization.
conditions: The traveler must obtain the territorial OK-to-Board authorization at least three business days before travel; the waiver is therefore normalized as ETA, not visa-free.
The program permits tourism and specified business only for up to 30 days; it requires a machine-readable passport, onward travel, lodging/host confirmation, fee, and admissibility.
Citizenship by investment is excluded. Work, credit study, residence, commercial-vessel boarding, diplomatic/official, special-document and other routes are excluded.
The Attorney General may modify the list by memorandum; entry remains discretionary.

application.label: American Samoa visitor-permit portal
steps: Apply for the territorial visitor/waiver processing route before travel.
Provide the required travel, lodging and onward-travel information and pay the fee.
Present the approved OK-to-Board document to Immigration on arrival.

policies.title: American Samoa: Qatar U.S.-visa-waiver 30-day visitor permit
policies.summary: The current American Samoa Government waiver-country list names Qatar, and its current visitor portal requires a pre-travel, emailed 30-day permit for U.S.-visa-waiver-country travelers.
conditions: The traveler must apply before arrival, receive the emailed permit, and present it to Immigration; the pre-travel electronic approval is normalized as ETA rather than visa-free.
The current route is limited to a 30-day visitor permit and remains subject to passport validity, fee, purpose, admissibility, entry and other territorial conditions.
Work, residence, credit study, transit, diplomatic/official, special-document, U.S.-visa-holder and individual-admission routes are excluded.

application.label: American Samoa U.S. Visa / Waiver 30-Day Visitor Permit
steps: Apply and pay before travel using the territorial visitor-permit workflow.
Receive the emailed permit before departure.
Present the permit to American Samoa Immigration on arrival.

policies.title: Puerto Rico and U.S. Virgin Islands: Visa Waiver Program ESTA
policies.summary: CBP confirms that VWP-country citizens traveling for short business or tourism to Puerto Rico or the U.S. Virgin Islands require approved ESTA.
conditions: Only tourism or business stays of 90 days or less under the federal VWP are covered; ESTA must be approved before travel.
A compliant e-passport is required. Current federal disqualifications include specified prior travel/presence and certain dual nationalities; an approved ESTA does not guarantee admission.
Work, study for credit, residence, diplomatic/official, crew, special-document and a visitor-visa route are outside this policy.

application.label: U.S. ESTA
steps: Submit an ESTA application before travel.
Travel on an eligible e-passport for a permitted VWP purpose.
Request admission from CBP on arrival.

policies.title: Guam and Northern Mariana Islands: G-CNMI electronic travel authorization
policies.summary: The live CBP G-CNMI portal names this 12-passport cohort and requires a G-CNMI ETA for business or pleasure visits of 45 days or less.
conditions: The authorization is for Guam or CNMI only, for business or pleasure up to 45 days; it is not an ESTA or a visa and does not create access to other U.S. destinations.
Hong Kong requires an HKSAR passport and Hong Kong identification card. Taiwan eligibility is subject to the portal's Taiwan-specific conditions.
The State Department VWP page still refers to Form I-736 for this program; the current CBP G-CNMI portal's electronic authorization controls this normalized ETA route.
Passport, purpose, admissibility, onward-travel, prior-travel, security, residence, work, crew, transit, diplomatic/official and special-document conditions remain material.

application.label: G-CNMI ETA
steps: Create a G-CNMI ETA application before travel.
Provide passport, identity, contact, travel and eligibility information.
Travel only after authorization and request admission at Guam or CNMI.

policies.title: Guam and Northern Mariana Islands: other federal VWP passports require ESTA
policies.summary: For VWP passports not using the separate G-CNMI program, CBP states that international travel to Guam or CNMI under the federal VWP requires ESTA.
conditions: This records the federal VWP/ESTA route, not the G-CNMI program. It covers only tourism or business stays of 90 days or less, subject to federal VWP eligibility and admissibility.
A compliant e-passport and approved ESTA are required before international travel. The VWP prior-travel and dual-nationality exclusions can require a visitor visa.
Work, residence, credit study, crew, transit, diplomatic/official and special-document routes are excluded.

application.label: U.S. ESTA
steps: Submit an ESTA application before travel.
Use an eligible e-passport for a permitted VWP purpose.
Request admission from CBP at Guam or CNMI.

policies.title: Northern Mariana Islands: PRC CNMI EVS-TAP authorization
policies.summary: The live CBP G-CNMI portal expressly provides a CNMI EVS-TAP electronic authorization route for PRC citizens visiting the CNMI for 14 days or less.
conditions: This is a CNMI-only electronic authorization route for PRC citizens, for business or pleasure stays of 14 days or less; it does not establish entry to Guam or other U.S. destinations.
The live portal requires application, passport and eligibility information before travel; approval does not guarantee admission.
The State Department page's older Form I-736 wording conflicts operationally with the current electronic CBP portal; no route is inferred for PRC passports to Guam.
Residence, work, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, special-document, security and admissibility rules remain outside this policy.

application.label: G-CNMI ETA / CNMI EVS-TAP
steps: Create the CNMI EVS-TAP authorization application before travel.
Provide passport, identity, contact, travel and eligibility information.
Travel only after authorization and request admission in the CNMI.
